author: bardic-inspiration
name: Thinair Kestrel
summary: A small falcon that hunts above the snowline and drops on prey from straight overhead.
description: Thinair kestrels hover over the high passes like specks of ash, holding still against the wind for minutes at a time. Herders say one circling a camp means a storm by nightfall, and they are right more often than not.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.text: The kestrel doesn't provoke {ref:glossary/opportunity-attacks} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Stoop
traits.text: If the kestrel flies at least 30 feet straight down toward a target and then hits it with a Talons attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra {dmg:1d4:piercing}.
